READ the SLA document
FOR EACH SLA commitment DO
  IF commitment is 99.9% monthly uptime THEN
    IDENTIFY the metric to monitor as monthly uptime percentage
    SET the alerting threshold to less than 99.9% uptime
    DEFINE the measurement window as one calendar month
    GENERATE a sample Prometheus‑style alerting rule for uptime
  ENDIF
  IF commitment is read latency ≤200ms at the 95th percentile THEN
    IDENTIFY the metric to monitor as read latency at the 95th percentile
    SET the alerting threshold to greater than 200ms
    DEFINE the measurement window appropriate for latency measurement
    GENERATE a sample Prometheus‑style alerting rule for read latency
  ENDIF
  IF commitment is write latency ≤500ms at the 95th percentile THEN
    IDENTIFY the metric to monitor as write latency at the 95th percentile
    SET the alerting threshold to greater than 500ms
    DEFINE the measurement window appropriate for latency measurement
    GENERATE a sample Prometheus‑style alerting rule for write latency
  ENDIF
  IF commitment is error rate ≤0.1% of total requests THEN
    IDENTIFY the metric to monitor as error rate percentage of total requests
    SET the alerting threshold to greater than 0.1% error rate
    DEFINE the measurement window appropriate for error rate calculation
    GENERATE a sample Prometheus‑style alerting rule for error rate
  ENDIF
  IF commitment is maintenance windows up to 4 hours per month excluded from uptime calculations THEN
    IDENTIFY the metric to monitor as effective uptime excluding maintenance windows
    SET the alerting threshold to less than 99.9% effective uptime
    DEFINE the measurement window as one calendar month, excluding up to 4 hours of maintenance per month
    GENERATE a sample Prometheus‑style alerting rule for effective uptime
  ENDIF
  IF commitment is 48‑hour prior customer notification requirement THEN
    IDENTIFY the metric to monitor as notification compliance timing
    SET the alerting threshold to notification sent later than 48 hours before required event
    DEFINE the measurement window appropriate for tracking notifications
    GENERATE a sample Prometheus‑style alerting rule for notification compliance
  ENDIF
END FOR

parsed.body:
# Sample Prometheus alerting rules generated from the SLA commitments
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Monthly uptime >= 99.9%
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Metric: monthly_uptime_percentage
#   - Represents the percentage of time the service was up in the current calendar month.
# Alert: Trigger when uptime drops below 99.9% for the month.
# Measurement window: 1 calendar month (reset at the start of each month).

ALERT ServiceUptimeLow {
  expr: monthly_uptime_percentage < 99.9
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: "Service uptime is below 99.9% for the month"
    description: "The monthly uptime percentage fell below the SLA threshold of 99.9%.",
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read latency 95th percentile <= 200ms
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Metric: read_latency_seconds:95pct
#   - 95th percentile latency of read operations, in seconds.
# Alert: Trigger when latency exceeds 0.200 seconds.
# Measurement window: appropriate rolling window (e.g., last 5 minutes).

ALERT ReadLatencyHigh {
  expr: read_latency_seconds:95pct > 0.200
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Read latency 95th percentile exceeds 200ms"
    description: "95th percentile read latency is greater than 200ms, breaching the SLA.",
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Write latency 95th percentile <= 500ms
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Metric: write_latency_seconds:95pct
#   - 95th percentile latency of write operations, in seconds.
# Alert: Trigger when latency exceeds 0.500 seconds.
# Measurement window: appropriate rolling window (e.g., last 5 minutes).

ALERT WriteLatencyHigh {
  expr: write_latency_seconds:95pct > 0.500
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Write latency 95th percentile exceeds 500ms"
    description: "95th percentile write latency is greater than 500ms, breaching the SLA.",
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Error rate <= 0.1%
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Metric: error_rate_percentage
#   - Percentage of total requests that resulted in an error.
# Alert: Trigger when error rate exceeds 0.1%.
# Measurement window: typically a short window such as 5m.

ALERT ErrorRateHigh {
  expr: error_rate_percentage > 0.1
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: "Error rate exceeds 0.1% of total requests"
    description: "The error rate has risen above the SLA limit of 0.1% of total requests.",
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Effective uptime excluding maintenance windows
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Metric: effective_uptime_percentage
#   - Uptime percentage after excluding up to 4 hours/month of planned maintenance.
# Alert: Trigger when effective uptime falls below 99.9%.
# Measurement window: 1 calendar month, subtracting maintenance periods.

ALERT EffectiveUptimeLow {
  expr: effective_uptime_percentage < 99.9
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: "Effective uptime (excluding maintenance) is below 99.9%"
    description: "Effective uptime after accounting for approved maintenance windows is below the SLA target.",
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Notification compliance (48‑hour prior notice)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Metric: notification_lead_time_seconds
#   - Time between notification dispatch and the start of the planned maintenance event.
# Alert: Trigger when notification is sent less than 48 hours (=172800 seconds) before the event.
# Measurement window: each scheduled maintenance event.

ALERT NotificationLate {
  expr: notification_lead_time_seconds < 172800
  for: 0m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Customer notification sent less than 48 hours before maintenance"
    description: "The notification compliance timing is below the required 48‑hour advance notice.",
}
